test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who became the first official in India to be felicitated with United Nations Asia Environmental Enforcement Award in February 2021 under the *Gender Leadership and Impact category*?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sasmita Lenka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sasmita Lenka **became the first official in India to be felicitated with** United Nations Asia Environmental Enforcement Award **in **February 2021** under the **Gender Leadership **and **impact category.**
 
• **Sasmita Lenka**, who is a **divisional forest officer** in **Athgarh, Cuttack,** received the award under the **'Gender Leadership and Impact'** category for her work in helping in busting **pangolin smuggling rackets** in the **state**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Namita Gokhale** is the **author **of **twenty books **and the** Sahitya Akademi (National Academy of Letters)** awardee for** 2021.** She is **co-founder and co-director (with William Dalrymple) **of the** Jaipur Literature Festival.** Her acclaimed debut novel,** ‘Paro: Dreams of Passion’,** was **published **in **1984**. 
 
• **Inspector Sudarshan Panthee **received the **Asia Environmental Enforcement Award **from the **United Nations** for their role in arresting** notorious wildlife smuggler Kunjok Chhiring Lama in June 2020.**
